Overview

Ondo City is a city in Ondo with a population of 490,000. The historic capital of Ondo Kingdom, an agricultural and commercial center in southwestern Nigeria. Housing is more affordable than the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 7b growing zone supports Mild — wide variety of vegetables, many fruit trees. The population skews young, with a median age of 18.0.
